prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent 2D tabletop miniature token for Tales of Maj'Eyal, readable when the entire token is only 48 or 64 pixels wide.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact cave-troll-v2 token to redesign. Image 2 is the established forest troll token, supplied only as a comparison to AVOID duplicating its frontal broad-shouldered posture; match its painted material and neutral disc. Image 3 is the original tiny cave troll game sprite, only identity context.
Primary request: redraw the CAVE TROLL figure inside the same circular base to make a strongly distinct side-on crouching spear hunter. This is a deliberate new visual design, not a literal recolor of the source sprite.
Subject and pose: complete stocky hunched troll, a pronounced rounded back and long arms, body turned approximately 65 degrees toward the viewer's lower right. Show a clear sideward head/torso silhouette with one shoulder forward and one behind; NOT a symmetrical front-facing chest. Two bent legs and both entire feet are visible planted within the disc. Two separated hands grip ONE stout wooden spear, making one clean broad diagonal from lower-left toward upper-right. The shaft is thick enough to survive 48px reduction; one simple pale iron spearhead. Compact the spear to fit completely inside the round disc, with a visible gap before the rim.
Color design: desaturated pale gray-ochre / light clay-gray skin, warm grey highlights, less green than the old cave troll and forest troll. Use large readable light-and-shadow planes on the back and long arms. Brown minimal loincloth, ivory claws/tusks. Keep the eyes small. No glowing eyes.
Style/invariants: retain exactly the existing hand-painted carved miniature aesthetic, steep overhead three-quarter camera, upper-left soft lighting, dark charcoal-brown shallow round disc with a thin muted bronze bevel. Preserve the disc's size and circular footprint; body and spear should fill it confidently while staying fully inside. Maintain a large readable creature body; do not solve containment by making the creature tiny.
Composition: a centered COMPLETE single miniature and complete circular base with generous transparent margin on all four sides. No cropped feet, head or weapon. Genuine transparent alpha background outside the base, not black, white or checkerboard pixels.
Do not add faction-colored rings, rarity/gold rings, symbols, letters, numbers, labels, HUD, selection, smoke, scenery, floating shadows outside the disc or extra characters. Do not make a bust or portrait. No photoreal 3D plastic gloss. The distinguishing readable masses are a pale bent side profile and one diagonal spear, not small costume details.
reference_roles: edit target; preserve disc and painted style while redesigning silhouette
style and differentiation reference; do not duplicate frontal pose
original game sprite identity context, not a mandatory palette
image_processing: Copied generated PNG without pixel edits or alpha changes.
review: Pale gray-ochre and hunched three-quarter profile improve distinction from frontal olive forest troll. Full feet and body scale retained. Spear point projects beyond upper-right base rim: retain rejected original and perform one targeted containment edit.
selection: rejected due to spear overhang; retained for provenance
